_comment: Rework M1e (docs/CAMPAIGN-REWORK-PLAN.md rounds 81 and 85): the Career awards. Points are promotion points (tuned in testing). Art is the game's own (StreamingAssets/original/<artRoot>/...), loaded at run time; 'stripes' draw the ribbon when it is missing. 'navies' give each navy's own names (navies.json ids; 'generic' for any navy not listed) and its citation wording; 'allied' the award an ally's navy gives for helping its forces.

awards.name: Navy Cross
awards.deed: A carrier or capital ship sunk, or a battle won against clearly superior odds

awards.name: Navy Distinguished Service Medal
awards.deed: A decisive success for the command: a base taken or held against a landing

awards.name: Silver Star
awards.deed: A battle won outnumbered, or a crippled ship brought through a battle not lost

awards.name: Meritorious Service Medal
awards.deed: Four days engaged without losing a ship

awards.name: Bronze Star Medal
awards.deed: A destroyer or bigger, or a submarine, sunk

awards.name: Navy Commendation Medal
awards.deed: A battle won with losses under a fifth of the enemy's

awards.name: Navy Achievement Medal
awards.deed: A minor success: a run of kills, a raid on enemy shipping

awards.name: Combat Action Ribbon
awards.deed: The first battle of the career

awards.name: Presidential Unit Citation
awards.deed: To the task force, with a Navy Cross deed

awards.name: Navy Unit Commendation
awards.deed: To the task force, with a Distinguished Service Medal or Silver Star deed

awards.name: Meritorious Unit Commendation
awards.deed: To the task force, with a Bronze Star deed

awards.name: Navy Expeditionary Medal
awards.deed: Every 7 days in the theatre (at sea, for a task force)

awards.name: JMSDF Defense Memorial Cordon (allied service)
awards.deed: A battle won alongside JMSDF forces

awards.name: Mention in Despatches (Australia)
awards.deed: A battle won alongside Australian forces

awards.name: Distinguished Service Cross (Australia)
awards.deed: A Silver Star deed or higher alongside Australian forces

awards.name: Mention in Despatches
awards.deed: A battle won alongside British forces

awards.name: Order of the Cloud and Banner
awards.deed: A battle won alongside Republic of China forces

awards.name: Legion of Merit (Degree of Officer)
awards.deed: A battle won alongside US forces

awards.name: Order of Friendship of Peoples
awards.deed: A battle won alongside Soviet forces

awards.name: Medal of Friendship (People's Republic of China)
awards.deed: A battle won alongside Chinese forces

awards.name: Allied Commendation
awards.deed: A battle won alongside an ally's forces
